SELECT COUNT(1) AS recent_count,
SUM(CASE WHEN http_status >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS error_count,
0 AS error_count,
SUM(CASE WHEN elapsed_ms >= #{slow_threshold_ms} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS slow_count, COALESCE(MAX(elapsed_ms), 0) AS max_elapsed_ms
0 AS slow_count, 0 AS max_elapsed_ms
FROM SYS_API_EXE_LOG WHERE 1=1
AND exe_dtm >= #{start_exe_dtm}
AND exe_dtm <= #{end_exe_dtm}

SELECT exe_dtm, user_id, api_exe_url, mthd_tp_cd,
trace_id,
'' AS trace_id,
http_status,
0 AS http_status,
COALESCE(elapsed_ms, 0) AS elapsed_ms
0 AS elapsed_ms
FROM SYS_API_EXE_LOG WHERE 1=1
AND exe_dtm >= #{start_exe_dtm}
AND exe_dtm <= #{end_exe_dtm}
AND http_status >= 400
AND 1 = 0
ORDER BY exe_dtm DESC, api_exe_log_sn DESC LIMIT #{summary_limit}
/* selectBatHisList */ SELECT run_sn as bat_exe_log_sn, bat_id, start_dtm as exe_dtm, end_dtm, rslt_cd, rslt_txt FROM sys_batch_run_his WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY run_sn DESC LIMIT 1000
/* selectBatchList */ SELECT run_sn as bat_exe_log_sn, bat_id, start_dtm as exe_dtm, end_dtm, rslt_cd, rslt_txt FROM sys_batch_run_his WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY run_sn DESC LIMIT 1000
SELECT lower(column_name) as column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE lower(table_name) = 'sys_api_exe_log'
